title: Dige buñu wax ci kaw Embers
intro: Yaa ngi taxaw ci wetu safara gu tàng ci desert bi, ñuy tasaaroo bu baax. Nit ñi dañuy ñëw ngir daje ak nit ñi ci biir dal gi, benn mesaas rek lañuy nettali jaar-jaaru dige, jaaxle, ak ëlëg gu amagul.
clues: Nu jàll fu sori ngir yegg ci benn surga bu gëm ci desert bi.
Nu laaj ñu tasaare lakk ngir waajal lakk.
Nu waxtaan ak kenn ku woowoon xal ngir seddal ak kaaraange.
Nu yegal nit ku weesu at yi mu wara am doom, ndax daa am doom buy sooga judd.
Nu tuddee doom jiñ digoon Isaac.
Nu yëgal Ibrahim doom ju góor, xibaar bu yéeme bi daal di reetaanloo Ibrahim.

identity.label: Man Kan laa?
options: Malaaka yi indil Ibrahim xibaar bu neex ci Isaac
Malaaka ya artu Lut
Malaaka yiy yor jal bi
Malaaka yu jahannama
Malaaka yi ñu yónnee Nóoyin
identity.answer: Malaaka yi indil Ibrahim xibaar bu neex ci Isaac

trial.label: Jàngat/Xew-xew
options: Yobbu xibaar bu neex ci juddug Isaac ci Ibrahim
Àrtu Lut laata muy mbugal askanam
Di yëgle juddug Yahya ci Zakariyya
Yobbu Jalluwaay bi ci bis àtte ba
Di yëgle juddug Isa ci Maryam
trial.answer: Yobbu xibaar bu neex ci juddug Isaac ci Ibrahim

location.label: Ëlëm bu am solo
options: Safara buñ defaree lakk bu tasaaroo
Ark buy féey ci kaw ndoxu mbënd
Grotte buñu tëj ak xeer wuy xalangu
Montagne de argille durée par la brine
Seel buy dem ba ci asamaan si
location.answer: Safara buñ defaree lakk bu tasaaroo

outcome.label: Njureef
options: Xibar bu neex ci doom bu góor bu tuddu Isaac
Xibar bu neex ci doom bu góor bu tuddu Yahya
Tanneef Talut ngir nekk buur ci kaw doomi Israyil
Àrtu bu jiitu mbugalu waa Lut
Ndigal ñu tabax gaal balaa Mbënd mi
outcome.answer: Xibar bu neex ci doom bu góor bu tuddu Isaac

verse: And inform them about the guests of Abraham, (15:51)
